subtitle: Removes the 24fps cap on cutscenes, so they play smoothly at your normal frame rate!
description:
Removes the 24fps cap on cutscenes, so they play smoothly at your normal frame rate.

The game's cutscenes are locked to 24fps, which drops the whole game to 24fps while one is playing, and makes the animation move in 24fps steps. This mod unlocks them, so they run and animate at the same frame rate as the rest of your game.

Requirements

  • Blueprint Loader, which loads this mod

Install

  1. Close the game, and fully close the Minecraft Launcher if you use it.
  2. Open your Minecraft Dungeons II Paks folder.
    • Steam: Right click the game in your library, then Manage > Browse local files, then open Dungeons\Content\Paks
    • Minecraft Launcher: C:\XboxGames\Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks
    If you picked a different install folder in the Minecraft Launcher, it is Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks inside that folder.
  3. Create a folder called ~mods inside the Paks folder if there is not one already.
  4. Open the zip and move the UncappedCutscenes folder inside it into ~mods, so the files end up like this: Paks\~mods\UncappedCutscenes\UncappedCutscenes_P.pak

Uninstall

Delete the UncappedCutscenes folder from ~mods.
